Players Committee gallery image of [[Flagship]], present in the capture of 16 December 2007 at 20:14:29 UTC. A bronze round mark is visible at the lower right. The complete image retains its published black matte and drop shadow.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071216201429id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/dagobah/ds/flagship.gif exact PC gallery capture]. This establishes that the image was available by the capture time, not its first publication day.
